beats.headline: The second volume
beats.text: Milk's voice carries over Larracos: the crawlers in the rings have a present. Carl's Book of Voodoo is updated with a metric fuckton of entries and segmented into two volumes. The second is Carl's Book of Boom. It behaves like the first, about five hundred pages where the Book of Voodoo should by now have almost thirty thousand, and it zeroes in on the entry he is meant to find. He opens it at random. Crawler 1,982,122, Asi Hamami, a level 59 fox warrior, thanks him and has not lost hope. Below, a crude red lock and key. Eating the page gives a level 10 Lockpick skill for five minutes.

beats.headline: Mehmet's page
beats.text: An entry in the Book of Boom: Mehmet Or, a human Sipahi, final level sixty-two. He owned a bowling alley in Istanbul, left to him by his father. He asks Carl to forgive him for taking a deal; he has too much to lose. His daughters, Azra and Yaz, did not step into the light with him, and he believes they are alive where the children are kept. If Carl cannot save those who took deals, please find them and tell them their father loves them. His party's mage loved this spell. The drawing is an amateur bowling alley. The spell: Gutter Bumper, cast at level 9.

beats.headline: Bumpers away
beats.text: Rolling toward the raft, Carl has already eaten Mehmet's page. He casts Gutter Bumper, clicks on the river ahead, is warned that it will not cover the whole river, and deploys. Donut casts Ice Slick, and the river freezes along the bumpers in a winding line, half again as far as the cone would reach. It is not the explosive magic Carl is always hunting for, but here it is perfect. He never met Mehmet. He has heard of him: a support player who saved countless lives in Faction Wars.

beats.headline: Does your dad own a bowling alley?
beats.text: Lucia Mar's manner changes in an instant, shoulders hunched and afraid, and she grabs Carl by the shirt. A shining lady has told her that Carl knows her father, that he gave Carl a spell. Her name is Azra, and Yaz is here too, crying, while the goddess tells them Carl used their father's spell to win his races. Carl remembers the note in the Book of Boom he ate for the Bumper spell. Does your dad own a bowling alley? Yes, that's him. He is safe, Carl tells her, and he loves her.

beats.headline: Strapped in lightning
beats.text: Every hint about Scolopendra in the dungeon's descriptions has had one thing in common, and Carl has seen it: lightning. So every page in Carl's Book of Boom, Donut's A Banquet Fit for a Princess and the original Book of Voodoo that offered lightning magic has been removed, and they are strapped head to toe in lightning spells. Carl has consumed ten different spells; Donut has a dozen, and Elle too. And this is only a contingency, stacked on other contingencies.

relations.note: she taught the departing crawlers to paint their spells onto pages
